title: Three people posed before a large presentation screen with Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing and Innovation Academy logos
objects_and_counts: Three visible people standing in the photographed scene: two younger men standing left/center and one older man standing right. All three are facing the camera; none are identified by name in the scene itself.
One large illuminated presentation screen or digital backdrop occupying most of the image background.

One handheld cardboard or foamboard sign held by the two central people; the sign shows a crown graphic and the word WINNER in multicolored letters. The sign is held at waist height and is not obscured.
At least two printed logo panels or graphic blocks visible on the screen in the upper right region (one for Tam Wing Fan Innovation Wing and one for Innovation Academy).

Several lines of printed text visible on the screen behind the people (partially cropped at left and right); this text is part of the projected/displayed background rather than objects in the photographed scene.
No other fixed equipment (e.g., podiums, chairs, tables, microphones) is clearly visible in the image; if present they are out of frame or obscured.

The older man wears a dark navy or black suit jacket with a white dress shirt.
